WITH customer_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.histcompref,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (cr.scoredate::date - INTERVAL '1 year' * cr.tenureyrs)) || '-Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM (cr.scoredate::date - INTERVAL '1 year' * cr.tenureyrs)) AS cohort_quarter,
        (bt.chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' IN ('High') OR bt.chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' IN ('High')) 
            AND (bt.chaninvdatablock->>'autopay' = 'Yes') AS is_digital_native,
        0.4 * ca.produsescore + 0.3 * ca.chanusescore + 0.2 * bt.bankrelscore + 0.1 * (ca.custservint::numeric / 10.0) AS ces
    FROM credit_accounts_and_history ca
    JOIN core_record cr ON ca.histcompref = cr.coreregistry
    JOIN bank_and_transactions bt ON ca.histcompref = bt.bankexpref
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort_quarter,
        is_digital_native,
        COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
        ROUND(CAST(AVG(ces) AS numeric), 4) AS engagement_score,
        ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ces > 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS numeric), 2) AS high_engagement_pct_by_status
    FROM customer_data
    GROUP BY cohort_quarter, is_digital_native
),
cohort_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort_quarter,
        ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ces > 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS numeric), 2) AS pct_cohort_high_engagement
    FROM customer_data
    GROUP BY cohort_quarter
)

    g.cohort_quarter,
    g.is_digital_native,
    g.cohort_size,
    g.engagement_score,
    c.pct_cohort_high_engagement,
